Uses existing tiny native database verification fixture; not another full populated-database restore and not cloud publication.

limitations: Representative content hashes/checksums and tar object sizes are synthetic. This proves supported manifest capacity for real path/count/size shape, not actual S3 object identity or complete production coverage.
Large-metadata publication/restore used fake S3 and an existing tiny native schema fixture. The separate full-library restore proof remains authoritative for populated database coverage.

JSON masters still require a parsed in-memory representation. The artifact inventory and encoded-object downloads now stream; measured process RSS covers this particular full-size fixture, not every future input.
